title: What Changes the Price of a Houston Roof
description: There is no honest single price for a roof in Houston. Pitch, layers, deck, access, and the material move the number.
html:
Anyone who quotes a Houston roof from a street photo is guessing. The number moves with the house, not with a coupon.

What moves it

  • Steep pitches and cut-up roofs take longer and use more metal at the valleys and walls.
  • A second layer has to come off. The dumpster and the labor are part of the job.
  • Soft deck shows up on tear-off. Boards we have not seen yet are not in a firm number until we have.
  • Access matters. A tight lot, a pool along the eave, or a long carry from the driveway changes the day.
  • Shingles, metal, tile, and stone-coated steel are different materials. The cheap comparison is usually two different roofs.

We do not publish a price per square here, because that number would be wrong for the next house. How people spread a real invoice is in paying for a roof without draining savings and on the financing page. What the deck can do to the number is in soft decking on a tear-off.
